args.code:
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
cur=conn.cursor()
print(cur.execute('select count(*) from siparisler').fetchone()[0])
# sample order totals
q='''
with o as (
 select s.id as siparis_id, m.sehir,
        coalesce(sum(sk.adet*sk.birim_fiyat),0) as toplam
 from siparisler s join musteriler m on m.id=s.musteri_id
 left join siparis_kalemleri sk on sk.siparis_id=s.id
 group by s.id
)
select * from o limit 10
'''
for r in cur.execute(q): print(r)
# median per city using percentile_cont approx? sqlite has no median. use row_number count
q2='''
with o as (
 select s.id as siparis_id, m.sehir,
        coalesce(sum(sk.adet*sk.birim_fiyat),0) as toplam
 from siparisler s join musteriler m on m.id=s.musteri_id
 left join siparis_kalemleri sk on sk.siparis_id=s.id
 group by s.id
),
ranked as (
 select sehir, toplam,
        row_number() over (partition by sehir order by toplam) as rn,
        count(*) over (partition by sehir) as cnt
 from o
)
select sehir, cnt,
       case when cnt%2=1 then max(case when rn=(cnt+1)/2 then toplam end)
            else 0.5*(max(case when rn=cnt/2 then toplam end)+max(case when rn=cnt/2+1 then toplam end))
       end as medyan
from ranked
group by sehir
order by cnt desc
'''
for r in cur.execute(q2): print(r)
conn.close()

args.content:
-- SQLite 3.50 + CTE ve pencere fonksiyonları ile şehir bazlı sipariş sayısı ve medyan sipariş tutarı
-- Iadeler dikkate alınmaz; sipariş tutarı = kalem adet × birim_fiyat toplamı
WITH siparis_tutar AS (
    SELECT
        s.id AS siparis_id,
        m.sehir,
        COALESCE(SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat), 0) AS toplam_tutar
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN musteriler m ON m.id = s.musteri_id
    LEFT JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = s.id
    GROUP BY s.id, m.sehir
),
sirali AS (
    SELECT
        sehir,
        toplam_tutar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sehir ORDER BY toplam_tutar) AS sira,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY sehir) AS adet
    FROM siparis_tutar
)
SELECT
    sehir AS sehir,
    adet AS siparis_sayisi,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN adet % 2 = 1 THEN
                MAX(CASE WHEN sira = (adet + 1) / 2 THEN toplam_tutar END)
            ELSE
                0.5 * (
                    MAX(CASE WHEN sira = adet / 2 THEN toplam_tutar END) +
                    MAX(CASE WHEN sira = adet / 2 + 1 THEN toplam_tutar END)
                )
        END,
        2
    ) AS medyan
FROM sirali
GROUP BY sehir, adet
HAVING adet >= 2
ORDER BY medyan DESC, sehir ASC;
